sourceChecks.note: The official L'Epée page was checked on 2026-09-03 and confirms Time Machine as a mechanical sculpture/table clock, its 25.7 x 22 x 21cm dimensions, 5.2kg weight, in-house calibre 1855, 8-day power reserve, and standard references. It is explicitly not a wristwatch.
Bucherer’s exact product listing was checked on 2026-09-03 and identifies the Bucherer-exclusive Time Machine as reference 74.6001/114_BUC.
The Bucherer/Tourneau listing was checked on 2026-09-03 and corroborates manufacturer reference 74.6001/114_BUC and the brass-palladium, manual-winding clock configuration.
